purpose: Post hoc matched comparison of confidence scores under the frozen Estonia protocol
test_status: The official Estonia test role was already opened by Stage 31; all test results in this stage are descriptive diagnostics and cannot change the frozen policy.

fixed_data_roles.test_role: Stage 31 official Estonia final test, read only after calibration and policy freezing

pmax.description: Maximum softmax probability; reproduces the primary frozen protocol

margin.description: Top-one minus top-two softmax probability margin

selection_contract.multiplicity: Bonferroni over five fixed thresholds and two one-sided bounds per score family
selection_contract.selection: earliest mean stopping index among certified calibration candidates; ties by higher coverage then lower threshold

interpretation_rules: Do not retrain models or alter dates, splits, class vocabulary, or the frozen primary policy.
Do not select a comparator score family or threshold using final-test outcomes.
Report this stage as a post hoc matched diagnostic, not as an independent blind replication.
If no comparator candidate is certified, report NO_CERTIFIED_POLICY rather than relaxing thresholds or targets.
